verdict.rationale: Dispute handling is a fair question for a payments Merchant of Record, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a disputes API for retrieving disputes, assembling evidence, or submitting responses. The MCP server's documented scope (products, customers, subscriptions, orders, benefits) and the refunds feature are adjacent capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
